title: glab api projects/${source}
description: The project a merge request's branch lives in, read by its id when it is not this project, whose namespace's full path kit reads as the fork's owner in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:open-prs). The types are APIEntitiesProjectsWithAccessAndCatalogSetting and APIEntitiesNamespaceBasic of GET /api/v4/projects/{id} in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/projects/ describes it.

full_path.description: The path of the group, with its parent groups, or of the user that owns the project.
